ABOUT THIS READING EDITION

Scripture first. Context alongside.

The scripture text shown here is the King James Version. It is displayed as provided in the source text; study notes and illustrations are visually separate and do not change the verse wording.

Strong’s links identify a Hebrew or Greek dictionary entry associated with a word in the KJV. The contextual note is a study suggestion based on the verse and lexical entry. Strong’s glosses are brief historical definitions; grammar, idiom, textual history, and literary setting matter too. Compare the original entry and judge for yourself.

This edition preserves the Genesis context notes prepared for the earlier Genesis study draft. Other passages show a concise passage-specific reading note when a tagged word is selected.

Sources: King James Version text and KJV Strong’s word tags from jsonBible; Strong’s lexicon public-domain text. Genesis notes: Genesis Contextual Study Edition draft, 2026. Illustrations are original vector study scenes.
